stem.text: Which statement about aluminium chloride is correct?

A.text: Aluminium chloride has a much higher melting point than magnesium chloride due to the small size of the aluminium ion.

B.text: Anhydrous aluminium chloride reacts vigorously with water to form a solution with a pH greater than 7.

C.text: Each $\text{Al}_2\text{Cl}_6$ molecule found in aluminium chloride vapour contains two coordinate bonds.

D.text: The bonding between aluminium and chlorine is strongly ionic due to the large difference in electronegativity.
